# Accepted-risk advisories for pip-audit.
#
# One advisory ID per line. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# The security workflow turns each ID into a `--ignore-vuln` flag.
#
# RULE: an entry may only be added when the fixed version cannot be selected
# within the current dependency graph. Every entry must name the blocking
# upstream pin and why the vulnerable code path is unreachable here.
# Re-check on every mitmproxy upgrade.

# --- Blocked by mitmproxy's own pins (mitmproxy 12.x) ----------------------
# Verified from installed metadata:
#   cryptography<=48.1  (fixed: 49.0.0 / 50.0.0)
#   h2==4.3.0           (fixed: 4.4.1)
#   msgpack<=1.1.2      (fixed: 1.2.1)
#   tornado<=6.5.5      (fixed: 6.5.7 / 6.5.8)
# These are hard upper bounds in mitmproxy itself, so the fixed releases cannot
# be selected without forking it. This server runs no Tornado HTTP server and
# its outbound requests use curl_cffi, not SimpleAsyncHTTPClient; h2/msgpack are
# used inside mitmproxy's own connection handling.
